text:
elaine: Heads-up: running a dry-run with a vendor next Tue. Aim: validate RBAC handoff, KMS key-wrap/usage, evidence ingest, PII-scrub, and retest booking. looping @tariq @kevin @nisha
tariq: Keep it staging-only and timeboxed (3h). Ephemeral SSO roles only. We'll reject any requests for CI tokens.
kevin: I'll spin up an OIDC session role `pt-dryrun-{id}` that limits actions to read/list/describe on staging ARNs and disallows write/delete. KMS: offer a short-lived data-key flow (GenerateDataKey + Decrypt) scoped to a PT CMK alias. We'll wrap keys and rotate after the window.
nisha: Audit checklist: enable CloudTrail management + S3 object-level data events for the ingest prefix. Forward events to our SIEM with tag `pt_id:<id>`. Retain logs 395 days. Also enable alerting for ObjectLock tamper attempts.
presign-bot: [INFO] Presign policy: single-part PUT only, max 200MB for dry-run, require x-amz-meta-sha256 and x-amz-meta-pt_id. Return structured JSON logs to /pt-presign.
vendor-bot: Quick Q: do you accept zipped bundles (.zip) and a manifest file?
tariq: Yes, zipped bundles allowed. Require a companion manifest JSON listing member files with sizes and sha256. Manifest filename pattern: manifest-{pt_id}-{ts}.json.
kevin: Minimal KMS statement to give vendor visibility: {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-dryrun-2026"}
elaine: Ingestion pipeline: presign -> upload -> async validator lambda validates checksum, runs a lightweight PII scrub (emails, SSN patterns, credit card patterns), and if clean moves object to `locked/` with ObjectLock GOVERNANCE 14d. If PII flagged, object gets tag `pii:found` and stays in `quarantine/` until manual review.
nisha: Intake options: preferred = webhook creating a `PT Intake` card on vuln-tracker. Fallback = upload findings.json to ingest prefix. SLA: ack 24h, triage note 48h, remediation ETA: 3 business days for criticals.
kevin: Retest policy for dry-run: vendor may request one follow-up window within 7 business days after fixes. We'll offer two candidate slots: overnight (00:30-02:30 PT) or early morning (06:00-08:00 PT). Oncall to confirm staffing; post-window we rotate CMK and revoke sessions.
oncall: [BOT] PagerDuty stub PD-DRYRUN-30876 created. I can cover the overnight slot.
elaine: Action items (owner / due EOD): kevin: create session role + export session policy for vendor review; tariq: publish manifest schema + curl examples; nisha: enable CloudTrail + SIEM forwarding + retention; infra/presign: enforce presign constraints + checksum validator + quarantine workflow.
kevin: ack
tariq: ack
nisha: ack
elaine: I'll send the vendor handshake with the dry-run checklist and a short runbook (includes key-wrap note and PII handling) -> https://docs.internal.redwood/pt-dryrun-handshake (sending now). Closing thread unless vendor needs HSM or cross-cloud SAS. Thanks all!
